title: German-Style Italian Potato Casserole
description: A hearty twist on traditional Italian cuisine, this potato casserole combines the best of both worlds.
instructions: Peel the potatoes and slice them thinly.
In a large skillet, cook the bacon until crispy, then set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the tomato sauce and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes, tomato sauce mixture, and cooked bacon.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Let the casserole rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.
